name: Purchase
description: A purchase — an expense transaction recording a cash/check/credit-card purchase.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: System-assigned unique identifier for the Purchase. Required for update/get/delete (passed as id).

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Used for optimistic concurrency; must be supplied on every sparse update.

fields.name: PaymentType
fields.description: The account funding type of the purchase. Required on create.

fields.name: AccountRef
fields.description: Reference to the bank or credit-card account funding the purchase. For PaymentType Check, the bank account; for CreditCard, the credit-card account. Required on create.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items of the purchase. At least one line is required on create. Each line carries a DetailType discriminator that determines which *LineDetail object is populated.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Line item identifier, unique within the transaction.

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: Position of the line in the collection.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Free-form description of the line item.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line. Required when the line is present. Max 15 digits in the integer part.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating which line-detail object is populated for this line.

attributes.name: AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail
attributes.description: Populated when DetailType is AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail. Categorizes the expense against an expense account.

attributes.name: AccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the expense account the line is charged against.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced expense Account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: BillableStatus
attributes.description: The billable status of the expense line.

attributes.name: TaxAmount
attributes.description: Sales tax paid as part of the expense (used with global tax model).

attributes.name: MarkupInfo
attributes.description: Markup information for the billable expense.

attributes.name: PriceLevelRef
attributes.description: Reference to a PriceLevel for the markup.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced PriceLevel.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name.

attributes.name: Percent
attributes.description: Markup amount expressed as a percent of the cost.

attributes.name: MarkUpIncomeAccountRef
attributes.description: Account in which the markup is recorded.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the income account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name.

attributes.name: CustomerRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Customer/Project this expense is associated with or billable to.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Customer.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Customer.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class for this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: TaxInclusiveAmt
attributes.description: The total amount of the line including tax (used when amounts are tax-inclusive).

attributes.name: ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail
attributes.description: Populated when DetailType is ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail. Used to record the purchase of products/services tracked as items.

attributes.name: ItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Item purchased.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Item.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class for this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: PriceLevelRef
attributes.description: Reference to a PriceLevel for this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced PriceLevel.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced PriceLevel.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: BillableStatus
attributes.description: The billable status of the line item.

attributes.name: Qty
attributes.description: Number of items purchased.

attributes.name: UnitPrice
attributes.description: Unit price/cost of the item.

attributes.name: TaxInclusiveAmt
attributes.description: The total amount of the line including tax.

attributes.name: CustomerRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Customer/Project this line is associated with or billable to.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Customer.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Customer.

attributes.name: MarkupInfo
attributes.description: Markup information for the billable item line.

attributes.name: PriceLevelRef
attributes.description: Reference to a PriceLevel for the markup.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced PriceLevel.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name.

attributes.name: Percent
attributes.description: Markup amount as a percent of the cost.

attributes.name: MarkUpIncomeAccountRef
attributes.description: Account in which the markup is recorded.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the income account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name.

fields.name: EntityRef
fields.description: Reference to the payee of the purchase (Vendor, Customer, or Employee). The Type sub-field qualifies which entity kind is referenced.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced payee entity.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced payee.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of entity the reference points to.

fields.name: PaymentMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to the PaymentMethod for this purchase.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced PaymentMethod.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced PaymentMethod.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: Reference to the Department (location tracking) for this purchase.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Department.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Department.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency of all amounts on this transaction. Available only when multicurrency is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full currency name.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home-currency units required to equal one unit of the transaction currency. Used only with multicurrency.

fields.name: Credit
fields.description: When PaymentType is CreditCard, indicates whether this is a refund/credit (true) rather than a charge (false). Ignored for Cash/Check.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date of the purchase transaction. Defaults to the current date if not supplied.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction (e.g. check number). Throws an error if custom transaction numbers are not enabled and a value is supplied.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: A private, user-entered memo not visible to the payee. Max 4000 characters.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Transaction-level sales-tax details, including the tax code applied and the calculated tax line(s).

attributes.name: TxnTaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the transaction-level TaxCode.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding any line-level overrides.

attributes.name: TaxLine
attributes.description: Individual tax lines, one per tax-rate detail.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: Tax amount for this tax line.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator for the tax line detail.

attributes.name: TaxLineDetail
attributes.description: Details of the applied tax rate.

attributes.name: TaxRateRef
attributes.description: Reference to the applied TaxRate.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced TaxRate.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: True if the tax rate is percentage-based.

attributes.name: TaxPercent
attributes.description: The tax rate percentage applied.

attributes.name: NetAmountTaxable
attributes.description: The net taxable amount this tax line is computed on.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method used to apply tax for the transaction. Applicable only to companies that use automated sales tax / global tax model.

fields.name: PrintStatus
fields.description: Print status of the transaction (relevant for check-type purchases).

fields.name: IncludeInAnnualTPAR
fields.description: Indicates whether the purchase is included in the annual TPAR (Taxable Payments Annual Report). Applicable to Australia (AU) editions only.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction in the transaction currency, including tax. System-computed from the lines.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: Reference to the recurring-transaction template (RecurringTransaction) this purchase was created from.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced RecurringTransaction.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced template.

fields.name: TxnSource
fields.description: Used internally to specify originating source of a transaction (e.g. IntuitPayment).

fields.name: LinkedTxn
fields.description: Linked/related transactions (e.g. a Purchase linked to a reimbursable charge).

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: The Id of the linked transaction.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: The type of the linked transaction (e.g. ReimburseCharge).

attributes.name: TxnLineId
attributes.description: The specific line Id of the linked transaction, when applicable.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The platform domain of the object. Internal use; always QBO.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: When true on a request, indicates a sparse (partial) update so omitted fields are preserved rather than nulled.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: System-maintained descriptive metadata about the object.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the object was created (read-only).

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the object was most recently updated (read-only).
